ColorNormalDice.Name: Color normal dice
ColorNormalDice.Hint: Apply the selected normal palette to standard Arkham dice. Disabled by default so players keep their personal Dice So Nice appearance unless they opt in.

ColorHorrorDice.Name: Color horror dice
ColorHorrorDice.Hint: Apply the Arkham horror-die role to horror dice rolled by the Arkham Horror RPG system.

NormalDicePalette.Name: Normal dice palette
NormalDicePalette.Hint: World-wide Dice So Nice colors for Arkham normal dice. Investigator Standard Black is the default.

HorrorDicePalette.Name: Horror dice palette
HorrorDicePalette.Hint: World-wide Dice So Nice colors for Arkham horror dice. Horror Eldritch Green is the default.
